runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Fresh locality-gated sweep actually searched Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. New readable candidates included Wolt Support Associate, Kariera part-time assistant and a fresh Upwork WordPress/WooCommerce technical role. None was promoted: Wolt requires minimum B2 English and shifts to 01:00, Kariera pays only 600 EUR for 20h/week, and the Upwork role is hard technical PHP/MySQL/server work with 50+ proposals. Facebook has 0 verified hits. Existing LIVE jobs remain fail-closed because safe complete jobs-data.json round-trip replacement cannot be guaranteed by the current repository read surface.

developmentChanges.title: Late-shift household impact score
developmentChanges.reason: Track evening/weekend/after-midnight shift burden separately from generic shift work so customer-support roles ending around 01:00 are penalized realistically even when remote.

developmentChanges.title: Part-time income density score
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize part-time offers by weekly hours and gross hourly equivalent, then compare against commute and fixed household costs so superficially convenient 20h roles do not outrank economically stronger options.
